profile_text.body:
Apollo Global Management describes itself as an asset manager, capital provider, and provider of wealth and retirement solutions. According to its site, the firm creates strategies it characterizes as innovative and differentiated, and it presents private credit as a way to promote resiliency in financial systems, fuel business growth, and power retirement income. It also says it is addressing approximately $90T worth of investments needed to power what it calls the Global Industrial Renaissance, and that Apollo and Athene have been delivering investment solutions across the retirement ecosystem for more than three decades.

The site highlights case studies and research on private markets, including work in which Apollo's long-duration capital and aviation expertise helped an airline, and it features senior leaders discussing the firm's progress, long-term growth opportunities, strategy, and financial outlook.

Apollo Global Management is a public company traded under the ticker APO, with a CIK of 0001858681. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
